title: Compliance Professional - Consultor(A) (Analista Pleno - Power Automate)
description:

- Análise de Dados e Automação: contribuir na coleta, tratamento e visualização de dados para suportar decisões em compliance digital;
apoiar iniciativas de automação e governança de processos.

- Colaboração Multidisciplinar: atuar em conjunto com TI, Segurança, Rede e áreas de negócio, propondo soluções que facilitem o cumprimento dos requisitos de compliance sem perder eficiência operacional.

- Garantir atuação no modelo Agile gerenciando solução de suporte e demandas necessárias para diretoria de Risk & Compliance.

- Garantir evolução e melhorias para solução de GRC implementada.


Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação:

- Experiência em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC) - Experiência em controles internos e frameworks de TI e Segurança (CoSO, COBIT, ITIL, NIST, ITGC, SoD, IT Risk Assessment). - Project Management no modelo Agile e tradicional Waterfall, e ferramentas de marcado como Azure Devops.

- Experiência na plataforma Microsoft e gerenciar banco de dados como Power BI, PowrApps, Power Automate fundamental, Dataverse

- Experiência em soluções de IA como Copilot premium e Studio, e soluções de Multi-agentes.

- Conhecimento em controles e requisitos de segurança da informação/Compliance.

- Graduação em Sistemas da Informação, TI ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificação em Riscos e Controles: CCSA (Certification in Control Self-Assessment), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control);
- Certificação em Agile/Scrum (PSM, CSM) ou PMP com ênfase em metodologias ágeis;

- Certificações Data Analytics, ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau);

- Certificação emprodutos Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Hr Specialist
description:
About the Role

The HR Specialist plays a key role in managing the full employee lifecycle for Employer of Record (EOR) clients and employees across multiple countries. This includes onboarding, responding to employment-related inquiries, ensuring compliance, and overseeing offboarding procedures.

The position requires continuous collaboration with internal teams, clients, and external partners to deliver seamless HR operations while maintaining compliance with local, national, and international employment laws.

As a subject matter expert in global HR operations, the HR Specialist leads complex cases, drives compliance initiatives, and supports the training and development of new team members. This role partners closely with leadership and clients to deliver strategic HR solutions across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full employee lifecycle for EOR employees, including onboarding, employment changes, and offboarding in assigned countries.
  • Respond to client and employee inquiries through the ticketing system;
    participate in meetingsand handle escalations as needed.
  • Monitor updates to local employment laws and ensure alignment with global HR compliance standards.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant employee records while safeguarding HRIS data integrity.
  • Prepare employment contracts, addendums, new hire guidelines, and other HR documentation with accuracy and compliance.
  • Review, update, and apply company policies to align with local regulations and best practices.
  • Guide clients and internal teams on statutory leave requirements and country-specific HR practices.
  • Manage voluntary terminations and support involuntary termination processes, collaborating with local counsel when required.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance HR operations and service delivery.
  • Work closely with partners, in‑country providers, account managers, payroll teams, and the legal team to ensure integrated and compliant operations.
  • Support additional HR‑related tasks and special projects as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of global HR practices and international employment law compliance.
  • Excellent communication skills with cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and global labor standards.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
  • Proficiency with HRIS systems, Salesforce, and the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Strong problem‑solving abilities and a continuous improvement mindset.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • HR certification preferred (e.G., SHRM‑CP, PHR).
  • 3+ years of HR experience, preferably within a global or EOR environment.
  • Knowledge of international employment laws and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing escalations.

You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations.   • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.

  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.

  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.

  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.


Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.

  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.

title: It Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role;
experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.G., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

Sobre a vaga

Resumo da posição

Será o ponto focal para a coordenação e garantia de sucesso dos projetos de implementação (onboarding) de novos clientes e das iniciativas de desenvolvimento de produto da plataforma ColmeIA.

Este profissional é crucial em nossa estratégia de curto tempo de implementação e de evolução contínua de produto/jornada, que se baseia em arquitetura modular, IA e integração multicanal (WhatsApp, e-mail, etc.).

O papel exige:

  • Forte capacidade de comunicação
  • Experiência de contato direto com cliente
  • Gestão de stakeholders
  • Profundo entendimento do ciclo de vida de projetos de software
  • Experiência com implantação de soluções B2B SaaS (Software as a Service)


Responsabilidades


Planejamento e Escopo

  • Apoiar e acompanhar o Analista de Negócios no detalhamento do escopo de cada projeto de onboarding, em linha com o que foi acordado com as equipes de Vendas

  • Utilizar metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban ) para acompanhar o progresso da equipe de onboarding
  • Garantir visibilidade do andamento para o cliente e áreas envolvidas


Gestão de Riscos

  • Identificar proativamente gargalos e riscos que possam atrasar a entrega ou comprometer a qualidade da solução implementada

  • atraso na entrega de conteúdo pelo cliente
  • problemas de integração relatados pelos desenvolvedores do projeto


Qualidade e Entrega

  • Assegurar que a solução entregue esteja em conformidade com os requisitos definidos
  • Garantir que os fluxos de automação atendam corretamente às regras de negócio


Transição

  • Coordenar a transição do projeto de onboarding para a equipe de Suporte
  • Garantir que a documentação e as métricas iniciais de performance estejam claras e organizadas


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

A ColmeIA valoriza a diversidade e oferece igualdade de oportunidades em seus processos seletivos.

Atenção: apenas candidatos nível Sênior , com boa pontuação no teste online , serão considerados aptos para seguir no processo.

Nosso objetivo é garantir uma avaliação justa, transparente e baseada exclusivamente nos conhecimentos reais de cada candidato.

Será considerado aprovado para a próxima etapa o candidato que atingir pontuação mínima de 70% no teste Coderbyte , sem identificação de irregularidades durante a execução.


Etapas do processo seletivo

  1. Triagem inicial de perfil, competências e análise das respostas enviadas através do LinkedIn
  2. Teste técnico online (Coderbyte)
  • Link enviado por e-mail a todos os candidatos triados na etapa anterior
  • Pontuação mínima exigida: 70%
  • Verificação de integridade durante a execução
  1. Entrevista online com RH e responsáveis pela área


Importante: informação sobre o teste online

O teste deverá ser realizado sem acesso a qualquer ferramenta de consulta externa , como:

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus


ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Solution Architect


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions and document to-be business processes leveraging industry best practices.
  • Identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, excel sheets, emails and others.
  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Architects and Directors to develop clear functional and technical design and document data requirements and build complex datasets.
  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform as per the design to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.
  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.
  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans
  • Work with Internal Research and Development Teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases and document issues and track progress at resolving issues.
  • Ability to design a testing protocol and implement with support from Junior Analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.
  • Work with Cross-Functional Teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.
  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.
  • Mentor Junior Analysts to familiarize them with technical and business aspects of a project.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization.
  • Experience presenting on complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner
  • Prior experience in planning systems, and exposure to ERP tools
  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover, and value realization
  • Experience using agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise implementations
  • Education: Master’s Degree +4 or Bachelor Degree with 6 year experience required. Degrees in the following fields: in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields (including Supply Chain Engineering) with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Skills:

  • Supply planning experience and have worked or implemented one or multiple supply planning products is required
  • Knowledge of spreadsheets and software (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required
  • Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is required
  • Strong analytical techniques, data mining knowledge and proficiency in handling and processing large amounts of data is preferred
  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is preferred Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics is required
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required
  • Ability to communicate mathematical, technical or software usage concepts to audiences with limited prior mathematics, technical or software background is preferred
  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy is required


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works

  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More About Us


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Analista De Engenharia De Dados Pleno
description:
Buscamos um profissional com perfil "End-to-End" para atuar na

interseção entre Engenharia de Dados e Business Intelligence. Sua missão será conectar o

mundo técnico do Databricks com a camada de decisão no Power BI. Você não apenas

validará os dados, mas atuará na construção das tabelas finais (Gold Layer) e no

desenvolvimento de dashboards performáticos, garantindo que a visualização reflita com

precisão as regras de negócio de Mídia.


Principais atribuições:


- Atuar na engenharia e modelagem de dados no Databricks (SQL/PySpark), realizando transformação de dados e criação/otimização de views e tabelas na camada Gold.

- Desenvolver e manter modelagens dimensionais (Star Schema/Snowflake) para garantir performance e eficiência no consumo via Power BI.

- Implementar e automatizar regras de negócio diretamente na origem, estruturando cálculos e tratamentos para eliminar ajustes manuais no Power Query.

- Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais no Power BI com alto padrão visual, storytelling e melhores práticas de UX/UI.

- Desenvolver medidas avançadas em DAX para análises complexas, incluindo KPIs de mídia como Year-over-Year, Share of Voice e indicadores acumulados.

- Realizar manutenção evolutiva de relatórios existentes, assegurando consistência técnica e visual conforme novas demandas do negócio surgirem.

- Conduzir análises e troubleshooting ponta a ponta, investigando divergências desde medidas DAX até queries SQL no Data Lake.

- Gerenciar governança dos workspaces no Power BI Service, incluindo organização de publicações, controle de acessos e atualização de datasets.


Requisitos


- Power BI em nível intermediário, com domínio de linguagem DAX, conhecimento em Power Query (M) e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (relacionamentos, cardinalidade, desempenho e otimização de datasets).

- SQL em nível intermediário/avançado, com habilidade para escrever queries complexas, incluindo CTEs e Window Functions, para manipulação de dados e validação de regras de negócio.

- Experiência intermediária com Databricks e PySpark, incluindo uso de notebooks, leitura de tabelas Delta e manipulação básica de DataFrames (filtro, agregações e tratamentos via código).

- Entendimento sólido de pipelines de dados, compreendendo as etapas de ingestão, tratamento e visualização, e sabendo identificar onde atuar quando ocorre alguma falha no fluxo.



Diferenciais:


- Vivência com dados de marketing digital e mídia (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, entre outras plataformas).

- Conhecimento em Python para criação de scripts auxiliares.

  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;
  • Day Off de Ações Voluntárias
  • Comitê de D&I .


Sobre a dentsu internacional


Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco


Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade


Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras


Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

title: Analista De Processo De Manufatura Pleno
description:
Este é o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para silvicultura, gramado e jardim e construção. Como uma das start-ups mais antigas do mundo, estamos em uma jornada emocionante, trabalhando juntos em um ambiente global acelerado, onde nos desafiamos continuamente a continuar inovando e reinventando nossos negócios.

Com nossa paixão pela inovação, criamos produtos e serviços para clientes em todo o mundo. Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais e entendemos que nossas diferenças são nossos pontos fortes. Somos curiosos, ousados e construídos por nossas diferenças. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e candidatos. Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.

Hoje, o Grupo está com uma oportunidade como Analista em Processos de Manufatura que pode ser a sua cara, confira abaixo:

O escopo da função é de principalmente apoiar no processo de expansão da planta com o desenho e estruturação de processos de produção das novas linhas de montagem.


O que você vai fazer:

Será responsável pelos processos e projetos de todas as linhas de montagem (assembly lines) da nossa manufatura: executar simulações, gerenciar restrições de custo e tempo e realizar avaliações de risco;

Realização de cronoanálise: determinar quanto tempo e esforços são necessários para a execução de cada tarefa na linha;

Análise de tempose métodos: análise de tempos e movimentos em nossa linha de produção, com o objetivo de otimizar processos e eliminar desperdícios;

Desenvolvimento emelhoria de padrões de trabalho/instruções técnicas/procedimentos operacionais;

Atualização e confecção de documentações técnicas da nossa manufatura;

Realização do controle dimensional: verificar de modo eficiente as características dimensionais de peças, subconjuntos ou equipamentos, de modo a garantir a montagem, o bom funcionamento, a manutenção e a intercambiabilidade de peças e componentes;

Inovação. Tecnologia e Sustentabilidade.

Na Vallourec, somos mais do que uma empresa: somos um parceiro confiável que cria soluções inovadoras para os setores de energia, indústria e construção.

Com mais de 120 anos de história, presença em 20 países nos cinco continentes e mais de 13.000 colaboradores, estamos na vanguarda da tecnologia e da sustentabilidade.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Sobre a Agropalma


A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

Regional Sales Manager (RSM)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Company: Hanwha Vision

About Hanwha Vision


Hanwha Vision is a global leader in video surveillance and security solutions, part of the Hanwha Group. We develop advanced technologies that help create safer, smarter environments across industries such as retail, transportation, critical infrastructure, and smart cities.


As part of our continued growth in Latin America, we are seeking a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) based in São Paulo, Brazil , to drive revenue growth and market expansion for our video surveillance and security solutions across the assigned territory.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan for the assigned region.
  • Identify and develop strategic system integrators with tailored growth plans.
  • Execute regional action plans aligned with the company’s overall sales strategy.


Relationship Management

  • Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with system integrators, distributors, and key end customers.
  • Conduct regular meetings with strategic accounts to understand needs and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Generate demand through large end users in collaboration with consultants, engineers, architects, and technology partners.


Sales Support and Execution

  • Provide expert guidance on Hanwha Vision products and solutions.
  • Deliver sales presentations, both in-person and virtually, to promote the product portfolio.
  • Support integrators in solution design, proposal development, deal closure, and project execution.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, ensuring timely and accurate product delivery.


Order Coordination and Logistics

  • Coordinate with internal teams and distributors to ensure accurate and timely order processing.
  • Monitor order status and proactively resolve any issues.


Market Analysis and Strategic Development

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of customers, opportunities, market trends, and competitors.
  • Conduct market research to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Develop strategies to increase market share and achieve regional sales targets.


Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Analyze sales performance metrics and forecast regional revenue.
  • Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, and results.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Technical Support teams to align initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the STEP program to ensure system integrators maintain certifications and receive appropriate training.
  • Provide strategic market feedback to senior management to support product and marketing development.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar sales role within the technology, electronic security, or video surveillance industry.
  • Proven experience working with system integrators and distributors .

  • Strong negotiation skills, strategic thinking, results-driven mindset, and customer orientation.
  • Availability to travel within Brazil and the region as required.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in video surveillance technology.
  • High-impact regional role with strategic autonomy.
  • Professional growth within an international organization.

title: Technical Project Specialist
description:
ZTE is looking for The Technical Project Specialist – Data Center / IDC is a hybrid technical delivery and project execution role , responsible for supporting end-to-end delivery of Integrated Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical E&M projects , from bid support and estimation through planning, site execution, commissioning, acceptance, and handover .

This role operates in a matrix organization , with no direct people management , and acts as a technical project owner at execution level , coordinating internal teams and external contractors to ensure scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and acceptance objectives are met.


Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Support end-to-end project delivery for Data Center / IDC E&M projects , including electrical and HVAC scope.
  • Translate bid assumptions into execution plans, schedules, and acceptance criteria .
  • Coordinate site execution activities in alignment with approved scope, schedule, and quality standards.

Bid Support, Estimation & BOM

  • Support bidding and pre-sales activities with technical inputs.
  • Prepare or validate cost estimations , Bill of Materials (BOM) , and delivery assumptions.
  • Provide technical and execution inputs to protect project feasibility and margins.

Planning & Schedule Control

  • Develop and maintain baseline project schedules (e.G., MS Project, Primavera or equivalent).
  • Track progress, critical path, risks, and deviations, proposing corrective and mitigation actions.

Site Coordination (Matrix Environment)

  • Coordinate technical activities across engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, finance/contracts , and external vendors/subcontractors .
  • Ensure alignment on scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, testing, and acceptance readiness .
  • Act as a technical focal point during execution, without direct people management.

Quality, HSE & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support and verify compliance with HSE, site safety, and quality requirements .
  • Ensure adherence to applicable Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) , including NR-10 (Electrical Safety) and NR-35 (Work at Height) , according to project scope.
  • Support audits, inspections, and closure of non-conformities.

Commissioning, Acceptance & Handover

  • Coordinate commissioning and acceptance readiness , including punch lists, test evidence, and acceptance documentation.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover packages to customers.

Cost Control & Collections Interface

  • Track execution cost drivers and efficiency.
  • Support payment milestone and collections readiness by ensuring technical and acceptance deliverables are completed in line with contractual requirements.

Process Improvement & Digital Tools

  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of IDC delivery processes, controls, and reporting .
  • Promote use of digital tools for planning, reporting, and documentation control.

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

  • Act as a technical interface with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners .
  • Support customer satisfaction through transparent communication and execution discipline.


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical infrastructure project delivery ,
  • or equivalent experience in critical electrical or HVAC construction projects with site exposure.
  • Proven experience supporting project execution and customer acceptance in construction or mission-critical environments.
  • Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial/Production Engineering , or related fields is preferred .
  • Technical/technologist degrees may be considered with strong hands-on experience in mission-critical environments.
  • English : Advanced (mandatory ) – spoken and written.
  • Portuguese : Fluent (mandatory ).
  • Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish: nice to have.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical systems or HVAC for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, site documentation, and specifications .
  • Experience with AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, execution tracking, risk and issue management , and acceptance preparation.
  • Basic contract and scope awareness related to milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in multi-stakeholder environments.


Mobility

Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management, Operations, or Engineering.
  • Experience in large-scale or international data center projects .
  • Familiarity with commissioning and testing of mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with MS Project, Primavera , advanced Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Exposure to documentation control , including change logs, punch lists, and handover documentation.
  • Knowledge of HSE practices in construction or critical environments.


If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Gerente Tributário De Impostos Indiretos
description:
About the role


Atuar como Gerente Tributário de Impostos Indiretos , liderando o cumprimento fiscal e as atividades de consultoria tributária no Brasil. O papel garante aderência total à legislação vigente e futura (incluindo a Reforma Tributária – LC 214), além de suporte estratégico a stakeholders internos. Será responsável por gerir riscos fiscais, otimizar processos, liderar projetos estratégicos e garantir eficiência operacional.

Conduzirá uma equipe de 8 analistas (Júnior e Pleno) e atuará como parceiro-chave para diversas áreas da empresa.


Key responsibilities


  • Liderar projetos para identificação e mitigação de riscos fiscais, bem como oportunidades de benefícios e otimizações.
  • Revisar continuamente processos, dados mestres, parametrizações e transações para garantir conformidade tributária eficiente.
  • Coordenar o fechamento mensal, assegurando cálculos e conciliações corretas de impostos indiretos.
  • Supervisionar a elaboração e entrega pontual de declarações e obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, EFD-Reinf, DCTFWeb, FCI, CIAP, entre outras).
  • Atuar como consultor interno sobre tributação indireta para áreas como Compras, Supply Chain, Customer Care e Jurídico.
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação e liderar a implementação das adequações necessárias em processos e sistemas.
  • Garantir a correta configuração tributária no SAP (FI, SD, MM) e em sistemas relacionados.
  • Monitorar e assegurar a aplicação correta de regimes especiais, incentivos e créditos fiscais.
  • Dar suporte em auditorias internas e externas, coordenando planos de ação quando identificados riscos.
  • Consolidar informações estratégicas sobre impactos da Reforma Tributária durante o período de transição (a partir de 2026).
  • Liderar iniciativas de automação tributária, utilizando Excel avançado, Power BI e ferramentas fiscais.
  • Manter documentação atualizada de processos e controles, promovendo melhorias contínuas.
  • Desenvolver, capacitar e motivar o time, promovendo treinamento cruzado e evolução profissional.


Qualifications and skills


  • Graduação em Contabilidade ou Direito.
  • 6 anos de experiência como Manager liderando equipes de impostos indiretos.
  • Inglês conversacional / avançado.
  • Profundo conhecimento dos tributos indiretos brasileiros: ICMS, ICMS-ST, DIFAL, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS, IRRF, PCC, INSS .
  • Conhecimento de GAAP Brasileiro .
  • Entendimento sólido da Reforma Tributária (LC 214) e dos impactos operacionais, contábeis e sistêmicos no curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Forte conhecimento em SAP (FI, SD, MM) ;
    experiência com Guepardo será diferencial.
  • Excel avançado, Power BI e ferramentas de análise aplicadas a processos fiscais.
  • Capacidade de interpretar legislação e traduzir regras tributárias em parametrizações e processos efetivos.
  • Experiência com auditorias internas/externas e interface com autoridades fiscais.
  • Vivência prévia em consultorias (Big Four ), ou equivalentes é um diferencial.
  • Liderança sólida, com capacidade de motivar e desenvolver equipes.
  • Pensamento estratégico com forte visão de negócio.
  • Foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e prevenção de multas e penalidades.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de influenciar stakeholders em diferentes níveis.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar projetos e conduzir transformações.
  • Visão crítica para melhoria contínua de processos.


About Kerry


Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Product Owner
description:
Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas.


Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real.


Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):

Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por:

Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade.

Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade.

Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução.


Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:

1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)

Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.

Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.

Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.

2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica

Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.

Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.

3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)

Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento.

Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais.

Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.


Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)

Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes.

Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas.

Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres).

Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável.

Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.

Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total.


Diferencial Competitivo

IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia.

title: New Product Evaluation Leader - Quality
description:
Job Purpose:

The New Product Evaluation analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, and compliance of new products and product transfer projects. This role plays a key part in planning and executing test protocols, managing quality issues, and converting customer and regulatory requirements into actionable quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate new products and transfer projects to ensure they meet performance, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Develop and organize validation protocols, test plans, and quality checklists.
  • Identify, document, and manage quality issues through a closed-loop process, including root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Translate customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements into clear, actionable criteria for development and manufacturing teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain during product development and transfer.
  • Participate in pilot runs and provide quality feedback to optimize processes before mass production.
  • Maintain accurate records of test results, reports, and technical documentation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related technical field.
  • Solid knowledge and experience in quality management;
    hands-on experience in new product evaluation is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills;
    proficient in Excel andquality tools such as Six Sigma, SPC, QC methods, etc.
  • Effective communicator with strong organizational and stress management skills.
  • Fluent in English;
    proficiency in Portuguese and Chinese is a plus.
  • Customer-oriented, results-driven, resilient, and committed to integrity and continuous improvement.


工作内容：

  1. 负责新品及转产项目评价；
  2. 负责新品及转产项目测试项目制定及组织开展测试；
  3. 负责新品及转产项目问题闭环管理；
  4. 负责新品及转产项目品质要求转化。

任职资格

  1. 具备相关的学术背景和专业知识；
  2. 1-3年以上质量管理工作经验，从事过新品评价等相关工作经验优先；

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.


We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP .



In this role, you will:

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases.
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you:

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

title: Analista De Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado.
